name: macro-cache
description: Free, open-source, Claude-native macro tracker. Self-hosted on Cloudflare's free tier.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core && tsc -p apps/worker && tsc -p apps/dashboard
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler deploy && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote

ALLOWED_GITHUB_USER.description: Your GitHub **username**: the only account allowed to sign in.

GITHUB_CLIENT_ID.description: Client ID of a [GitHub OAuth app](https://github.com/settings/applications/new) with callback `https://<worker-url>/callback`.

GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Client secret of that GitHub OAuth app.

COOKIE_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Any long random string, e.g. `openssl rand -hex 32`.

DB.description: D1 database for your foods, logs and weights (created automatically).

OAUTH_KV.description: KV namespace for OAuth grants (created automatically).
